1 Slave function

This is the core computational unit located on each worker node.

It queries the survival data (time, event, and predictors) and calculates the Risk Score for each patient using the current coefficients: \(Risk=e^{\sumβ_iz_i}\).

Two-Phase Execution:

If the Master sends an empty array of global times, the slave simply returns a list of unique event times found in its local data. Once the Master provides the global_times, the slave calculates three vital statistics for every time point t: - S0: Sum of risks of patients still at risk at time t. - S1: Weighted sum of predictors (\(z⋅Risk\)) for patients at risk. - S2: Weighted outer product of predictors (\(z⋅z^T⋅Risk\)). - Event Sum: The sum of predictors for patients who actually experienced the event at time t.

Code 
library(DBI)
library(RPostgres)

###############################################################################
#Slave - Cox Hazard Survival Model
###############################################################################

slave_cox <- 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION slave_cox_js(
  table_name text,
  time_column text,
  event_column text,
  x_columns text[],
  beta float8[],
  global_times float8[] 
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  stats jsonb,
  n int
)
LANGUAGE plv8
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$

function zeros(n,m){ return Array.from({length:n},()=>Array(m).fill(0)); }

function outer(z){
  const p=z.length; const M=zeros(p,p);
  for(let i=0;i<p;i++) for(let j=0;j<p;j++) M[i][j]=z[i]*z[j];
  return M;
}

const p = x_columns.length;
const cols = x_columns.map(c => `"${c}"`).join(",");
const sql = `SELECT "${time_column}" AS t, "${event_column}" AS e, ${cols} 
             FROM "${table_name}" WHERE "${time_column}" IS NOT NULL`;
const rows = plv8.execute(sql);

let data = [];
for(const r of rows){
  let z = x_columns.map(c => {
    let v = Number(r[c]); return Number.isFinite(v) ? v : 0;
  });
  const t = Number(r.t);
  const e = Number(r.e);
  let eta = 0;
  for(let i=0;i<p;i++) eta += beta[i] * z[i];
  const risk = Math.exp(Math.max(-50, Math.min(50, eta)));
  data.push({t, e, z, risk});
}

data.sort((a,b) => a.t - b.t);

// FASE DI PRE-STEP: Se non ho global_times, ritorno solo i tempi degli eventi locali
if (!global_times || global_times.length === 0) {
    const local_events = [...new Set(data.filter(d => d.e === 1).map(d => d.t))];
    let res = local_events.map(t => ({ time: t }));
    return [{ stats: res, n: data.length }];
}

// FASE DI CALCOLO: Uso l array globale dei tempi imposto dal Master
let results = [];
for(const t of global_times){
  let S0 = 0, S1 = Array(p).fill(0), S2 = zeros(p,p);
  let event_sum = Array(p).fill(0);
  let count_events = 0;

  for(const d of data){
    if(d.t >= t){
      S0 += d.risk;
      for(let i=0;i<p;i++) S1[i] += d.z[i] * d.risk;
      const O = outer(d.z);
      for(let i=0;i<p;i++) for(let j=0;j<p;j++) S2[i][j] += O[i][j] * d.risk;
    }
    if(d.t === t && d.e === 1){
      count_events++;
      for(let i=0;i<p;i++) event_sum[i] += d.z[i];
    }
  }
  results.push({ time: t, S0, S1, S2, event_sum, count_events });
}
return [{ stats: results, n: data.length }];
$$;'

2 Master Function

Time Discovery: It connects to all slaves to identify every unique time point where an event occurred across the entire federation. It creates a sorted global_times array.

The Newton-Raphson Loop: It sends the current \(\beta\) and the global_times to all slaves via dblink.

Sums the S0, S1, S2, and Event Sums from all slaves for each time point.

Score Vector (U) and Hessian (I): It calculates the global log-likelihood gradient (U) and the information matrix (I).

It uses the formula: \(U=\sum(EventSum−d_t⋅mean)\) and \(I=\sum d_t⋅(\frac{S2}{S0}−mean⋅mean^T)\).

It inverts the Hessian and updates beta: \(β_{new}=β_{old}+I^{−1}U\).

Convergence: The loop breaks if the change in beta is smaller than the tolerance (tol).

Code 
###############################################################################
# Master - Cox Hazard Survival Model (CORRETTO - Scope I fixato)
###############################################################################

master_cox <- 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION master_federated_cox_plv8(
  slaves text[],
  tbl_name text,
  time_col text,
  event_col text,
  x_cols text[],
  tol float8 DEFAULT 1e-6,
  max_iter int DEFAULT 50
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  iteration int, term text, estimate float8, std_error float8, z_value float8
)
LANGUAGE plv8 AS $$

// ... [Mantieni le tue funzioni zeros, vecAdd, vecSub, matAdd, matVec, matInv] ...
function zeros(n, m) { return Array.from({ length: n }, () => Array(m).fill(0)); }
function vecAdd(a, b) { for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) a[i] += b[i]; }
function vecSub(a, b) { for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) a[i] -= b[i]; }
function matAdd(A, B) { for (let i = 0; i < A.length; i++) for (let j = 0; j < A[0].length; j++) A[i][j] += B[i][j]; }
function matVec(A, x) {
  const r = Array(A.length).fill(0);
  for (let i = 0; i < A.length; i++) for (let j = 0; j < x.length; j++) r[i] += A[i][j] * x[j];
  return r;
}
function matInv(A) {
  const n = A.length; const M = A.map(r => r.slice());
  const I_mat = zeros(n, n); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) I_mat[i][i] = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    let f = M[i][i];
    if (Math.abs(f) < 1e-12) continue; 
    for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) { M[i][j] /= f; I_mat[i][j] /= f; }
    for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
      if (k === i) continue;
      let g = M[k][i];
      for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) { M[k][j] -= g * M[i][j]; I_mat[k][j] -= g * I_mat[i][j]; }
    }
  }
  return I_mat;
}


const p = x_cols.length;
let beta = Array(p).fill(0);
let I_hessian; 

// --- PRE-STEP: SCOPERTA DEI TEMPI GLOBALI ---
let global_times_set = new Set();
const x_cols_pg = "{" + x_cols.join(",") + "}";

for (const s of slaves) {
  const conninfo = `host=${s} dbname=postgres user=worker_user password=worker`;
  const sql_discovery = `
    SELECT stats FROM dblink(
      ${plv8.quote_literal(conninfo)},
      format($q$ SELECT stats FROM slave_cox_js(%L, %L, %L, %L::text[], ARRAY[]::float8[], ARRAY[]::float8[]) $q$,
        ${plv8.quote_literal(tbl_name)},
        ${plv8.quote_literal(time_col)},
        ${plv8.quote_literal(event_col)},
        ${plv8.quote_literal(x_cols_pg)}
      )
    ) AS t(stats jsonb);
  `;
  const query_result = plv8.execute(sql_discovery);
  if (query_result && query_result.length > 0) {
    for (const row of query_result[0].stats) global_times_set.add(row.time);
  }
}
let global_times = Array.from(global_times_set).sort((a,b) => a - b);
const global_times_pg = "{" + global_times.join(",") + "}";
// ---------------------------------------------

for (let iter = 1; iter <= max_iter; iter++) {
  let U = Array(p).fill(0);
  I_hessian = zeros(p, p);
  let global = {};

  for (const s of slaves) {
    const conninfo = `host=${s} dbname=postgres user=worker_user password=worker`;
    const beta_pg = "{" + beta.join(",") + "}";

    // Chiamata passando l array global_times_pg
    const sql = `
      SELECT stats 
      FROM dblink(
        ${plv8.quote_literal(conninfo)},
        format($q$ SELECT stats FROM slave_cox_js(%L, %L, %L, %L::text[], %L::float8[], %L::float8[]) $q$,
          ${plv8.quote_literal(tbl_name)},
          ${plv8.quote_literal(time_col)},
          ${plv8.quote_literal(event_col)},
          ${plv8.quote_literal(x_cols_pg)},
          ${plv8.quote_literal(beta_pg)},
          ${plv8.quote_literal(global_times_pg)}
        )
      ) AS t(stats jsonb);
    `;

    const query_result = plv8.execute(sql);
    if (!query_result || query_result.length === 0) continue;

    const arr = query_result[0].stats;
    for (const row of arr) {
      const t = row.time;
      if (!global[t]) {
        global[t] = { S0: 0, S1: Array(p).fill(0), S2: zeros(p, p), event_sum: Array(p).fill(0), count_events: 0 };
      }
      const g = global[t];
      g.S0 += row.S0;
      g.count_events += row.count_events;
      vecAdd(g.S1, row.S1);
      matAdd(g.S2, row.S2);
      vecAdd(g.event_sum, row.event_sum);
    }
  }

  for (const t in global) {
    const g = global[t];
    if (g.S0 === 0) continue;
    
    const d_t = g.count_events;
    if (d_t === 0) continue; // Skip se non ci sono eventi globali a questo tempo

    const mean = g.S1.map(v => v / g.S0);

    for (let i = 0; i < p; i++) {
      U[i] += g.event_sum[i] - (d_t * mean[i]);
      for (let j = 0; j < p; j++) {
        I_hessian[i][j] += d_t * (g.S2[i][j] / g.S0 - mean[i] * mean[j]);
      }
    }
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < p; i++) I_hessian[i][i] += 1e-9;
  const Iinv = matInv(I_hessian);
  const delta = matVec(Iinv, U);

  let diff = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < p; i++) {
    beta[i] += delta[i];
    diff += Math.abs(delta[i]);
  }

  if (diff < tol) break;
}

const cov = matInv(I_hessian);
for (let i = 0; i < p; i++) {
  const se = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, cov[i][i]));
  plv8.return_next({
    iteration: max_iter,
    term: x_cols[i],
    estimate: beta[i],
    std_error: se,
    z_value: beta[i] / se
  });
}
return;
$$;'

3 Teach the new Functions to master and slaves than test

For testing purposes we suggest the bladder dataset from the survival package

Code 
library(survival)
bladder <- bladder
bladder$treatment <- bladder$rx - 1
bladder1 <- bladder[1:200,]
bladder2 <- bladder[201:340,]

###############################################################################
#Slave - Function Creation 
###############################################################################
con <- dbConnect(RPostgres::Postgres(),
                 host = 'localhost',
                 port = 5433,
                 user = 'postgres',
                 password = 'slv1')

dbWriteTable(conn = con, 
             name = "risk",
             value = bladder1,
             overwrite = TRUE)

dbExecute(conn = con,
          statement = slave_cox)

dbExecute(conn = con,
          statement = 'GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION slave_cox_js(text, text, text, text[], float8[], float8[]) TO worker_user;'
)
dbDisconnect(con)

con <- dbConnect(RPostgres::Postgres(),
                 host = 'localhost',
                 port = 5434,
                 user = 'postgres',
                 password = 'slv2')

dbWriteTable(conn = con, 
             name = "risk",
             value = bladder2,
             overwrite = TRUE)

dbExecute(conn = con,
          statement = slave_cox)

dbExecute(conn = con,
          statement = 'GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION slave_cox_js(text, text, text, text[], float8[], float8[]) TO worker_user;'
)
dbDisconnect(con)

###############################################################################
#Master - Function Creation end test
###############################################################################

con <- dbConnect(RPostgres::Postgres(),
                 host = 'localhost',
                 port = 5432,
                 user = 'postgres',
                 password = 'password')

dbExecute(con, master_cox)

qry_template <- "
SELECT *
FROM master_federated_cox_plv8(
  %s::text[],
  %s::text,
  %s::text,
  %s::text,
  %s::text[]
);
"
slaves_sql <- paste0(
  "ARRAY[",
  paste(DBI::dbQuoteString(con, c("slave1", "slave2")), collapse = ","),
  "]"
)

xcols_sql <- paste0(
  "ARRAY[",
  paste(DBI::dbQuoteString(con, c("treatment", "number", "size")), collapse = ","),
  "]"
)


qry_final <- sprintf(
  qry_template,
  slaves_sql,
  DBI::dbQuoteString(con, "risk"),
  DBI::dbQuoteString(con, "stop"),
  DBI::dbQuoteString(con, "event"),
  xcols_sql
)

res <- dbGetQuery(con,qry_final)
str(res)

test <- coxph(Surv(stop, event)~ treatment + number + size, bladder, ties = 'breslow')
summary(test)

4 Shared Data

4.1 Master to Slave

At each iteration, the Master sends this string/array to the Slave:

Database metadata: Table name and column names (tbl_name, time_col, event_col, x_cols).

β Vector: The array of current coefficients (e.g., [-0.27, 0.19, -0.05]).

Global Times Array (global_times): The list of all days/months in which at least one event occurred across the entire network (e.g., [12, 14, 18, 25…]).

4.2 Slave to Master

For each time t contained in the global_times array, the Slave returns a JSON object containing exclusively these 5 aggregated metrics:

S0 (Scalar): Anonymous sum of risks.

S1 (Vector): Anonymous sum of covariates multiplied by the risk.

S2 (Matrix): Anonymous sum of the cross-products of covariates multiplied by the risk.

count_events (Integer): How many people in the Slave experienced the event at exactly time t.

event_sum (Vector): The mathematical sum of the covariates (X values) of the patients who experienced the event at time t.

## SQL

# Slave function

This is the core computational unit located on each worker node.

It queries the survival data (time, event, and predictors) and calculates the Risk Score for each patient using the current coefficients: $Risk=e^{\sumβ_iz_i}$.

Two-Phase Execution:

If the Master sends an empty array of global times, the slave simply returns a list of unique event times found in its local data. Once the Master provides the global_times, the slave calculates three vital statistics for every time point t: - S0: Sum of risks of patients still at risk at time t. - S1: Weighted sum of predictors ($z⋅Risk$) for patients at risk. - S2: Weighted outer product of predictors ($z⋅z^T⋅Risk$). - Event Sum: The sum of predictors for patients who actually experienced the event at time t.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(DBI)
library(RPostgres)

###############################################################################
#Slave - Cox Hazard Survival Model
###############################################################################

slave_cox <- 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION slave_cox_js(
  table_name text,
  time_column text,
  event_column text,
  x_columns text[],
  beta float8[],
  global_times float8[] 
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  stats jsonb,
  n int
)
LANGUAGE plv8
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$

function zeros(n,m){ return Array.from({length:n},()=>Array(m).fill(0)); }

function outer(z){
  const p=z.length; const M=zeros(p,p);
  for(let i=0;i<p;i++) for(let j=0;j<p;j++) M[i][j]=z[i]*z[j];
  return M;
}

const p = x_columns.length;
const cols = x_columns.map(c => `"${c}"`).join(",");
const sql = `SELECT "${time_column}" AS t, "${event_column}" AS e, ${cols} 
             FROM "${table_name}" WHERE "${time_column}" IS NOT NULL`;
const rows = plv8.execute(sql);

let data = [];
for(const r of rows){
  let z = x_columns.map(c => {
    let v = Number(r[c]); return Number.isFinite(v) ? v : 0;
  });
  const t = Number(r.t);
  const e = Number(r.e);
  let eta = 0;
  for(let i=0;i<p;i++) eta += beta[i] * z[i];
  const risk = Math.exp(Math.max(-50, Math.min(50, eta)));
  data.push({t, e, z, risk});
}

data.sort((a,b) => a.t - b.t);

// FASE DI PRE-STEP: Se non ho global_times, ritorno solo i tempi degli eventi locali
if (!global_times || global_times.length === 0) {
    const local_events = [...new Set(data.filter(d => d.e === 1).map(d => d.t))];
    let res = local_events.map(t => ({ time: t }));
    return [{ stats: res, n: data.length }];
}

// FASE DI CALCOLO: Uso l array globale dei tempi imposto dal Master
let results = [];
for(const t of global_times){
  let S0 = 0, S1 = Array(p).fill(0), S2 = zeros(p,p);
  let event_sum = Array(p).fill(0);
  let count_events = 0;

  for(const d of data){
    if(d.t >= t){
      S0 += d.risk;
      for(let i=0;i<p;i++) S1[i] += d.z[i] * d.risk;
      const O = outer(d.z);
      for(let i=0;i<p;i++) for(let j=0;j<p;j++) S2[i][j] += O[i][j] * d.risk;
    }
    if(d.t === t && d.e === 1){
      count_events++;
      for(let i=0;i<p;i++) event_sum[i] += d.z[i];
    }
  }
  results.push({ time: t, S0, S1, S2, event_sum, count_events });
}
return [{ stats: results, n: data.length }];
$$;'
```

# Master Function

Time Discovery: It connects to all slaves to identify every unique time point where an event occurred across the entire federation. It creates a sorted global_times array.

The Newton-Raphson Loop: It sends the current $\beta$ and the global_times to all slaves via dblink.

Sums the S0, S1, S2, and Event Sums from all slaves for each time point.

Score Vector (U) and Hessian (I): It calculates the global log-likelihood gradient (U) and the information matrix (I).

It uses the formula: $U=\sum(EventSum−d_t⋅mean)$ and $I=\sum d_t⋅(\frac{S2}{S0}−mean⋅mean^T)$.

It inverts the Hessian and updates beta: $β_{new}=β_{old}+I^{−1}U$.

Convergence: The loop breaks if the change in beta is smaller than the tolerance (tol).

```{r, eval=FALSE}
###############################################################################
# Master - Cox Hazard Survival Model (CORRETTO - Scope I fixato)
###############################################################################

master_cox <- 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION master_federated_cox_plv8(
  slaves text[],
  tbl_name text,
  time_col text,
  event_col text,
  x_cols text[],
  tol float8 DEFAULT 1e-6,
  max_iter int DEFAULT 50
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  iteration int, term text, estimate float8, std_error float8, z_value float8
)
LANGUAGE plv8 AS $$

// ... [Mantieni le tue funzioni zeros, vecAdd, vecSub, matAdd, matVec, matInv] ...
function zeros(n, m) { return Array.from({ length: n }, () => Array(m).fill(0)); }
function vecAdd(a, b) { for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) a[i] += b[i]; }
function vecSub(a, b) { for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) a[i] -= b[i]; }
function matAdd(A, B) { for (let i = 0; i < A.length; i++) for (let j = 0; j < A[0].length; j++) A[i][j] += B[i][j]; }
function matVec(A, x) {
  const r = Array(A.length).fill(0);
  for (let i = 0; i < A.length; i++) for (let j = 0; j < x.length; j++) r[i] += A[i][j] * x[j];
  return r;
}
function matInv(A) {
  const n = A.length; const M = A.map(r => r.slice());
  const I_mat = zeros(n, n); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) I_mat[i][i] = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    let f = M[i][i];
    if (Math.abs(f) < 1e-12) continue; 
    for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) { M[i][j] /= f; I_mat[i][j] /= f; }
    for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
      if (k === i) continue;
      let g = M[k][i];
      for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) { M[k][j] -= g * M[i][j]; I_mat[k][j] -= g * I_mat[i][j]; }
    }
  }
  return I_mat;
}


const p = x_cols.length;
let beta = Array(p).fill(0);
let I_hessian; 

// --- PRE-STEP: SCOPERTA DEI TEMPI GLOBALI ---
let global_times_set = new Set();
const x_cols_pg = "{" + x_cols.join(",") + "}";

for (const s of slaves) {
  const conninfo = `host=${s} dbname=postgres user=worker_user password=worker`;
  const sql_discovery = `
    SELECT stats FROM dblink(
      ${plv8.quote_literal(conninfo)},
      format($q$ SELECT stats FROM slave_cox_js(%L, %L, %L, %L::text[], ARRAY[]::float8[], ARRAY[]::float8[]) $q$,
        ${plv8.quote_literal(tbl_name)},
        ${plv8.quote_literal(time_col)},
        ${plv8.quote_literal(event_col)},
        ${plv8.quote_literal(x_cols_pg)}
      )
    ) AS t(stats jsonb);
  `;
  const query_result = plv8.execute(sql_discovery);
  if (query_result && query_result.length > 0) {
    for (const row of query_result[0].stats) global_times_set.add(row.time);
  }
}
let global_times = Array.from(global_times_set).sort((a,b) => a - b);
const global_times_pg = "{" + global_times.join(",") + "}";
// ---------------------------------------------

for (let iter = 1; iter <= max_iter; iter++) {
  let U = Array(p).fill(0);
  I_hessian = zeros(p, p);
  let global = {};

  for (const s of slaves) {
    const conninfo = `host=${s} dbname=postgres user=worker_user password=worker`;
    const beta_pg = "{" + beta.join(",") + "}";

    // Chiamata passando l array global_times_pg
    const sql = `
      SELECT stats 
      FROM dblink(
        ${plv8.quote_literal(conninfo)},
        format($q$ SELECT stats FROM slave_cox_js(%L, %L, %L, %L::text[], %L::float8[], %L::float8[]) $q$,
          ${plv8.quote_literal(tbl_name)},
          ${plv8.quote_literal(time_col)},
          ${plv8.quote_literal(event_col)},
          ${plv8.quote_literal(x_cols_pg)},
          ${plv8.quote_literal(beta_pg)},
          ${plv8.quote_literal(global_times_pg)}
        )
      ) AS t(stats jsonb);
    `;

    const query_result = plv8.execute(sql);
    if (!query_result || query_result.length === 0) continue;

    const arr = query_result[0].stats;
    for (const row of arr) {
      const t = row.time;
      if (!global[t]) {
        global[t] = { S0: 0, S1: Array(p).fill(0), S2: zeros(p, p), event_sum: Array(p).fill(0), count_events: 0 };
      }
      const g = global[t];
      g.S0 += row.S0;
      g.count_events += row.count_events;
      vecAdd(g.S1, row.S1);
      matAdd(g.S2, row.S2);
      vecAdd(g.event_sum, row.event_sum);
    }
  }

  for (const t in global) {
    const g = global[t];
    if (g.S0 === 0) continue;
    
    const d_t = g.count_events;
    if (d_t === 0) continue; // Skip se non ci sono eventi globali a questo tempo

    const mean = g.S1.map(v => v / g.S0);

    for (let i = 0; i < p; i++) {
      U[i] += g.event_sum[i] - (d_t * mean[i]);
      for (let j = 0; j < p; j++) {
        I_hessian[i][j] += d_t * (g.S2[i][j] / g.S0 - mean[i] * mean[j]);
      }
    }
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < p; i++) I_hessian[i][i] += 1e-9;
  const Iinv = matInv(I_hessian);
  const delta = matVec(Iinv, U);

  let diff = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < p; i++) {
    beta[i] += delta[i];
    diff += Math.abs(delta[i]);
  }

  if (diff < tol) break;
}

const cov = matInv(I_hessian);
for (let i = 0; i < p; i++) {
  const se = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, cov[i][i]));
  plv8.return_next({
    iteration: max_iter,
    term: x_cols[i],
    estimate: beta[i],
    std_error: se,
    z_value: beta[i] / se
  });
}
return;
$$;'
```

For testing purposes we suggest the **bladder** dataset from the *survival* package

library(survival)
bladder <- bladder
bladder$treatment <- bladder$rx - 1
bladder1 <- bladder[1:200,]
bladder2 <- bladder[201:340,]

###############################################################################
#Slave - Function Creation 
###############################################################################
con <- dbConnect(RPostgres::Postgres(),
                 host = 'localhost',
                 port = 5433,
                 user = 'postgres',
                 password = 'slv1')

dbWriteTable(conn = con, 
             name = "risk",
             value = bladder1,
             overwrite = TRUE)

dbExecute(conn = con,
          statement = slave_cox)

dbExecute(conn = con,
          statement = 'GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION slave_cox_js(text, text, text, text[], float8[], float8[]) TO worker_user;'
)
dbDisconnect(con)

con <- dbConnect(RPostgres::Postgres(),
                 host = 'localhost',
                 port = 5434,
                 user = 'postgres',
                 password = 'slv2')

dbWriteTable(conn = con, 
             name = "risk",
             value = bladder2,
             overwrite = TRUE)

dbExecute(conn = con,
          statement = slave_cox)

dbExecute(conn = con,
          statement = 'GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION slave_cox_js(text, text, text, text[], float8[], float8[]) TO worker_user;'
)
dbDisconnect(con)

###############################################################################
#Master - Function Creation end test
###############################################################################

con <- dbConnect(RPostgres::Postgres(),
                 host = 'localhost',
                 port = 5432,
                 user = 'postgres',
                 password = 'password')

dbExecute(con, master_cox)

qry_template <- "
SELECT *
FROM master_federated_cox_plv8(
  %s::text[],
  %s::text,
  %s::text,
  %s::text,
  %s::text[]
);
"
slaves_sql <- paste0(
  "ARRAY[",
  paste(DBI::dbQuoteString(con, c("slave1", "slave2")), collapse = ","),
  "]"
)

xcols_sql <- paste0(
  "ARRAY[",
  paste(DBI::dbQuoteString(con, c("treatment", "number", "size")), collapse = ","),
  "]"
)


qry_final <- sprintf(
  qry_template,
  slaves_sql,
  DBI::dbQuoteString(con, "risk"),
  DBI::dbQuoteString(con, "stop"),
  DBI::dbQuoteString(con, "event"),
  xcols_sql
)

res <- dbGetQuery(con,qry_final)
str(res)

test <- coxph(Surv(stop, event)~ treatment + number + size, bladder, ties = 'breslow')
summary(test)

# Shared Data

## Master to Slave

At each iteration, the Master sends this string/array to the Slave:

**Database metadata**: Table name and column names (tbl_name, time_col, event_col, x_cols).

**β Vector**: The array of current coefficients (e.g., \[-0.27, 0.19, -0.05\]).

**Global Times Array (global_times)**: The list of all days/months in which at least one event occurred across the entire network (e.g., \[12, 14, 18, 25...\]).

## Slave to Master

For each time t contained in the global_times array, the Slave returns a JSON object containing exclusively these 5 aggregated metrics:

**S0 (Scalar)**: Anonymous sum of risks.

**S1 (Vector)**: Anonymous sum of covariates multiplied by the risk.

**S2 (Matrix)**: Anonymous sum of the cross-products of covariates multiplied by the risk.

**count_events (Integer)**: How many people in the Slave experienced the event at exactly time t.

**event_sum (Vector)**: The mathematical sum of the covariates (X values) of the patients who experienced the event at time t.
